structured_output.rationale: All three lines carry CO-29. The 277CA (2025-05-16) confirms the original claim was accepted 17 days post-DOS. The 837P in the artifacts is dated 2025-08-26 — a resubmission sent as CLM05-3=1 (new original), which landed outside the commercial filing window and triggered the untimely denial. The original was timely; appeal with the 277CA acceptance report to dispute the payer's receipt date.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 was triggered by the August 2025 resubmission (CLM05-3=1), not the original claim. The original was accepted by the clearinghouse on 2025-05-16 — 17 days post-DOS — well within any commercial filing window.

next_action.detail: File a redetermination/appeal attaching the 277CA (2025-05-16, STC A2:20, TRN TRC10649433) as proof of timely original submission. Dispute the payer's receipt date; do not plead forgiveness. Do not send another new original.
